'''Magna bolas''',<ref name="Core" /> or '''magna bolos''',<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> were a type of [[Bola/Legends|bola]] that consisted of three [[Metal/Legends|metallic]], [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] spheres connected by a thin metallic wire. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] could be thrown to entangle a target. The bola cost 500 [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]] and weighed one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Khlor]] was skilled with manga bolas and utilized them in his duties during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="Core" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Big Jak Targrim]]&mdash;leader of the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]&mdash;carried magna bolas.<ref name="Riders" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magna bolos first appeared in [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']], a [[1989]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Ray Winninger]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Riders" /> They were later identified as "magna bolas" in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] roleplaying sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" />
